answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fakes: each new identity pays a non-refundable 50-credit fee, burned at registration, before trading. Admission checks the receipt only; an honest agent pays once and recovers it. An attacker needing 100 fakes pays 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits up front, lost even if all fakes are ignored. A zephyr bends a lotus without breaking it; the fee barely troubles one real agent, yet strands a fake fleet on an island of sunk costs.
